falsifier_observable: After conditioning on chromosome, shared-site k, HP composition and candidate-set size, site-aware topology compatibility does not exceed the matched null; the signal is confined to k=2 or large candidate sets; read-full and VAF-top directions reverse; or HP split/merge dominates compatible calls.
red_team_failure_modes: Direct-heavy and k=2 algorithm priors create high agreement without site-specific reproducibility.
Existential candidate matching approaches one as the Cartesian candidate count grows.
HP-count mismatch or component-wise best swaps misclassify split/merge as a subtree.
VAF and candidate trees reuse the same reads and therefore are not independent evidence.
claim_ceiling: GO for full historical-v2 engineering comparison of same-cell-line cross-source technical reproducibility; biological tree accuracy and method efficacy remain NO-GO.
